items.title: sujithvarshan28/Diabetes-Prediction-System
items.abstract: Diabetes Risk Prediction System using Machine Learning and React. The project performs clinical risk assessment based on health and lifestyle inputs. Features include data preprocessing, ML classification, and a React UI with age ranges, tooltips, and risk-based outputs.
